note: Where the clinic and ward slot clips get their words. A clinic maps to a gazetteer entry whose name_hi is spoken in Hindi and Dogri; Urdu needs name_ur, which no gazetteer entry has, so Urdu clinic and ward clips wait for words. A clinic or ward with no source is listed by 'make_prompt_audio.py plan' as unavailable; nothing is guessed. To supply words by hand, add them under 'texts' (key is the clip name, for example clinic_cln_demo2 or ward_12).

cln_gmc.why: GMC Jammu anti-rabies clinic is in the Government Medical College and Hospital (OSM way/168951822, the same way data/clinics.json cites). The greeting no longer adds the city after the clinic, so the spoken clinic name carries it: see texts.*.clinic_cln_gmc.

texts_note: Hand-written by the build team on 19 Oct 2026 for the two demo clinics and GMC Jammu's spoken name (hi, doi, ur) and for every Urdu clinic and ward name (transliterated from the official ward names). Machine-quality drafts: a native Urdu speaker must check them before any real use. The en entries are never spoken: they are the English words under the captions of the browser phone, so they say what the hi clinic name says.
